notes.title: 1.7.0 Is out now!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Fellow Winemakers![/b]

As the harvest season winds down, we’re excited to bring you a BIG update for Hundred Days - Winemaking Simulator, now version 1.7.0! This update introduces a brand-new feature: the [b]Hall of Fame[/b]!

[i][b]What is the Hall of Fame?[/b][/i]

We’re glad you asked! The Hall of Fame helps you track your best scores and awards for each grape variety, giving you a new way to celebrate your achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/3efe416da8e22be17112df44813e42604cb6688c.png[/img]
In addition to this, we’ve also squashed many bugs you reported over the last few months. Thank you for your feedback and support!

Here is the full list:

[list]
[*] ADDED Hall Of Fame 
[*] FIX Problems during employees usage
[*] FIX Cleaning card popup after cleaning
[*] FIX Money bug in story mode
[*] FIX Quantity set to zero in must tab
[*] FIX Wine grape technologies locked in American Dreams Challenge (Napa)
[*] FIX next turn button during story
[*] FIX chinese terms translation
[*] FIX UI not displaying the correct cleaning status of the pneumatic presses
[*] FIX Scroll down on wine order panel
[/list]


Platform-specific changes
[list]
[*] FIX virtual keyboard issue on SteamDeck [Steamdeck] 
[*] Updated Android API [Android]
[*] FIX wine trend, weeding, treatments, trimming and order icons [Android]
[*] FIX grape inspector materials [Android]
[*] FIX vanilla/custom grape icon [Android]
[*] Updated "Term of service" and "Privacy policy" [Mobile]
[*] FIX save file loading [Mobile]
[*] FIX Black screen bug  [Mobile]
[*] FIX Banner impossible to close after completing a challenge [GAMEPAD]
[*] FIX Controller problem during challenge [GAMEPAD]
[*] FIX Virtual keyboard issue on ps5 [PS5]
[*] FIX "Continue" button at game start [PS5]
[*] ADD Back button close event panel [PS5]
[*] FIX Issue in design bottle page [PS5]
[*] Save files size test [PS5]
[*] Endless mode: hide custom grape tab [PS5]
[/list]

notes.title: September is here with a BIG update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Fellow winemakers![/b]
It's a long time we haven't updated the game, but we needed some time off to cure our vines and be sure to be ready for the harvest...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/4162d8c22045b6e0dabc494d8d1c06ef38e0d2ae.jpg[/img]

SPOILER: The Barbera harvest 2022 is going super!

To celebrate our come back updates we wanna start with a super important game changer... We are opening the Steam Workshop for Hundred Days - Winemaking Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/065884ae0009218df77cc39766f2bd48394748a4.png[/img]

[h2]STEAM WORKSHOP[/h2]
Now you can share and play with custom grapes directly from Steam Workshop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/7318fa2182e2ce0420115a6b0c01c91b4d74bf51.png[/img]

Once you subscribe to a custom made grape you will find it here, in the endless mode selection "WORKSHOP" tab:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/9d5f57704e88e941f8aacb057c3738f3af841335.png[/img]

If you want upload a custom made grape to the workshop instead, you need to make your grape in the Grape Lab free DLC and then upload it by clicking the following button:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/67396f74e1e0a74fb3e55d549947f06069f7e245.png[/img]

I hope you like this is new feature, on top of that there is some other changes, here the full list:

[list]
[*] ADDED WorkShop integration [Steam only]
[*] ADDED “easy” seed ( courtesy of AnimeDev from Discord server)
[*] FIX  Major bug fix on save file problems
[*] FIX it’s not possible to buy land before you receive the second letter in story mode
[*] FIX Missing label fix
[*] FIX Major and minor bug fix
[/list]

We have also received a lot of request to help translate the game in other languages, we have open a Crowd Sourced localization project in Crowdin:
https://crowdin.com/project/hundred-days-winemaking-simula

Reach out in case you are interested :)

That's All for this week update, remember if you like wine talks join our Discord Server:

https://discord.com/invite/jr3DwU3

As alway stay awesome 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/3bfba26902ebd804c5ac73d65d612acf85c30acf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/ea219b8e2fb109afb6861848e1d709adce9d1fb5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Happy Birthday & Patch note 1.5.0

We reached one year mark from the original release!!!! THANK YOU SO MUCH from the entire team for your amazing support! 
To celebrate we thought to make a bigger update with some new content and a lot of polish and request we collected during this months!

[h3]NEW AGING OPTION [/h3]
Batonnage joined the fight against the boredom of aging in wood casks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/f39197f5e7dd9f9afa932b13dda5cd093fd7ded1.jpg[/img]

[h3]NO MORE CLEANING! [/h3]
Finally we have trained employees to carefully clean and repair equipment now!

notes.title: News & Statement from the Team
notes.content:
Hello fellow winemakers!

It's friday again BUT this time no update for the game only some news about the future of Hundred Days!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/2ad3fa08e3cfd65a522ee23bb97ac490b09e6b6d.png[/img]

First of all the Game sales are super healthy so we are able to keep working on the game, the team is super healthy and motivated so we are eager to keep working on the game! ːlunar2019coolpigː

[h2]NEXT UPDATES[/h2]
The next update will be 13 of May with the 1.5.0 release to celebrate together the one year mark of the game, it will be a bigger, completely free, update to thank you all for the amazing support!

I will not spoiler too much what we gonna include in the update for now ;) 

[h2]NEGATIVE REVIEW[/h2]
I personally need to address some of the negative review that the game is getting lately. we read all the feedbacks and try really hard to implement what make sense.

A lot of players have problem in the early stage of the gameplay, and find frustrating the Tech Tree progression.

We have implemented a new option under TECHNOLOGIES where you can set the discount.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/0058993050f90f2a9e31817563afd0a0f0a46cd6.png[/img]

On top of that we are looking in to the balancing of the overall game economy, probabily it will be released with the 1.5.0. update.

That's All for this week update, remember if you like wine talks join our Discord Server:

https://discord.com/invite/jr3DwU3

notes.title: Roadmap 2021
notes.content:
Hello fellows winemakers!

As promised in the last patch note we are here to give you some information on what we are working on!
We will release 3 DLCs in the near future, and with near future we mean before the end of the year!

Let's talk about them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/b2b7503b718360aae9ff45167952e4110e8b46c6.jpg[/img]

The Grape lab will be our first free DLC. This expansion is more a tool than an actual new gameplay mechanics, in fact in the Grape Lab  you will be able to create your own variety of vines, or recreate your favourite ones, and play with them in the endless mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/7309d3d57fd4b2f543b704c8501fe9efc3300f86.png[/img]

You can expect this DLC somewhere around end of July/mid August.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/b5979dc538993d8aa3f1b12c42787a19feb61244.jpg[/img]

Napa Valley will be our first brand new wine region that lets you play in the famous California terroirs and wines like Zinfandel along with new gameplay mechanics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/0ddaed53adbe55dfc7fcf366056a189e29a8f718.jpg[/img]
Napa Valley concept!

Napa Valley DLC will be ready for end of September/mid October

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/d292059fa719714f680034d3d5935a00bce7fdb2.jpg[/img]

How could we do a Winemaking Simulator without touching a French wine region? The answers is "Of course not!"

So here we are, presenting to you the first Concept of the new Bordeaux wine region!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/159fc1bad4a97a2332c457fb3dd511d346f159c0.jpg[/img]

With this DLC we will also introduce a huge change to the gameplay... Blends and Cru! 
That's right you will be able, finally , make blends or decide to make single vineyards Cru!
Unfortunately Bordeaux DLC doesn't have yet a release timeframe, but we will keep you updated on that.

Along with those changes we will include:
[list]
[*] Wine aging and evolution after bottling
[*] Technical analysis of the wine that give you intelligence of what's going on before bottling and the techniques and tool to correct the wine before going to market like Filter, copper treatment, oxygenate the wine and much more
[/list]

This is an overview of the development direction we are taking and the whole team wants to personally thank you all for the amazing support and feedbacks!

Let's talk again on Friday with the patch notes for the 1.1.0 release

Stay awesome

Broken Arms Games

notes.title: Hundred Days - Winemaking Simulator
notes.content:
It takes a hundred days for a vine leaf to complete its life cycle: from spring to autumn, the leaves thrive and provide the fundamental energy to grow the grapes. 

Hundred Days will put you in charge of managing a small and abandoned winery: from selecting the types of vine you want to grow, to naming your final product, every decision of the challenging business of winemaking will be in your hands. Take care of your vineyard, learn to follow the rhythm of the seasons, harvest, label your bottles and sell them on the market: every choice you make will have an impact on the quality and quantity of the wine you produce and sell. Increase the reputation of your company worldwide, expand your business and manage the tight schedule of your daily tasks. Each turn will represent a day in your new life: once your business is up and running, attention to details will be key to succeeding in your endeavours. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/9931c14bfeb3dd4f5bc2fb36ab6f8569c7b23d39.jpg[/img]

In fact, as opposed to classical tycoon games, in Hundred Days you’ll make progress by constantly improving every aspect of your venture, honing your skills to perfection and meticulously planning the required activities: rather than mechanising the production, care and craftsmanship will be your guiding pillars. This is a winemaking simulator that will make you aware of the struggles endured by real-life winemakers, while rewarding you with the pleasures and secrets of a millenary tradition.
[previewyoutube=3Uf7Te-Vwio;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Our Story[/h3]
Hundred Days is a game about winemaking that involves balancing resources and managing time. However, even before considering it as a business, making wine must be understood as a complex art. To be a successful winemaker, you’ll need to get a grasp of chemistry, live by a strict routine, have a bit of luck, and infuse your craft with a lot of passion. In 1990 Yves Hohler, lead designer and co-founder of Broken Arms Games, moved with his family from Switzerland to Italy to pursue the path of winemaking. Even if at the time he was only a child, this decision has shaped his existence ever since: he attended and graduated from the Oenological High School Umberto I (in Alba, Italy) to become an expert in the field. At the moment, besides being a professional in the video game industry, he is still continuing the winemaking family business. [previewyoutube=EG4Q22o_ack;rightthumb][/previewyoutube] Loosely built on Yves personal experience, the game’s narrative can be considered partially autobiographical: the player, in fact, will start their journey from an abandoned winery, and will consolidate the business day-by-day, learning from their mistakes. Broken Arms Games, as a studio, is based in the Italian region of Piedmont which is renowned for the production of world-famous wines such as Chardonnay, Nebbiolo and Barbera, just to name a few. The entire team is deeply connected with the cultural heritage of Piedmont (a winemaking region) and this makes the experience depicted in the game a truly realistic simulation. Hundred Days takes pride in offering the player a thorough experience: real data provided from local winemaking businesses have been used and implemented in the game, while even the in-game tools and machinery are modelled after the real ones.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/jr3DwU3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/06a17214815a1be28a67d842f08658fc54df4d69.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/jr3DwU3]Link to Discord[/url]
[h3]Features[/h3]
“LEARN all the secrets of the winemaking business” - Handle the winemaking process from start to finish: understand the importance of different yeasts and bacteria strains, experiment with fermentation and wine aging to enhance the characteristics of your product.

“TAKE CARE of your vineyard” - Cultivate different types of vine, analyse the soil to understand what grapes will grow better, protect your vines from diseases, unexpected shifts in weather patterns, and learn what’s the best season to prune, fertilise, and harvest.

“MANAGE your sales” - Tailor the characteristics of your wine to meet the needs of your customers, customise your bottles by choosing their shape and color, apply branding and marketing strategies to increase your reputation.

“EXPERIMENT!” - Hundred Days will let you master cutting edge winemaking techniques and tools, while encouraging an artisanal approach: balance these two aspects to transform your business into a refined boutique label winery!

“AN ADVENTURE FOR ALL” - Test your ability to manage the winemaking business: Hundred Days is a tycoon game with a narrative twist, offering three different game modes to suit most palates. From beginner to expert, this winemaking simulator will entertain you while improving your general understanding of this millenary tradition and its cultural relevance.

notes.title: Dev Blog 03 - Nature System
notes.content:
This week we will talk about the dynamic systems in Hundred Days. 
Fundamentally there are 3 main system that the player can not control.

[h1]Seasons[/h1]
The games is turn based, every year has 20 turns, 5 turns per season
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/1ca07dea0c40a6eef9f282b761f074d32623f6cd.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/f263e134a39d27483e503888e8416c648f59bf24.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/06b833631ad46915468555e6c4dfa027c16635f1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/31fc9c03db728d00bbb82a9a24ce37a95cbd2736.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weather [/h1]
Weather has a HUGE impact on the gameplay, you must adjust your strategy to compensate the weather and temperature.

There are different weather conditions:
[list]
[*] Sunny
[*] Overcast
[*] Rain
[*] Snow
[*] Fog
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/02695f10abbf2852514e589091e0c3eb1a898aac.gif[/img]

This 5 condition occurs naturally through the seasons every year, but there are also some contingencies like:
[list]
[*] Storm
[*] Hail Storm
[*] Frostbite
[*] Heat waves
[/list]

[h1]Temperature[/h1]

The temperature is really important to help the ripe the grapes and to give them the right amount of flavor ( if your wine need it).

You can track the Season, weathercast and temperature in your handy calendar:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/9b0875c9bfbc2d27b2d63b414534143288b89816.jpg[/img]

[h1]Soil[/h1]

It’s really important to study well the soil before you plant your new vineyard, because all the data have a big impact on the type of work you have to do and of course not every terrain is good for every vine type.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414373/1d301f8237d6b1623764df0ea9398cd35ad3f5f6.jpg[/img]
Fore Example, Grandpa's vine has a almost unrealistic Slope (50%), if you don’t perform Terracing you will not be able to work with your tractor in the vineyard, taking much longer ( more turn's) to finish the tasks, on the other hand you can have a higher Planting Density and produce more grapes.

notes.title: Dev Blog 02 - Buildings
notes.content:
First off, we would like to thank all of you for wishlisting Hundred Days! Your interest in our game and your fantastic feedback so far is absolutely outstanding.
We were really busy preparing Gamescom, but now we have finally time to share with you where we are now and what we are working on!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/125a9132ac5ffccbac755875b6ae3beb209f98df.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/e9e7322e7e8938ed07dc996e549a2a31c235ee7e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Buildings[/h1]

[b]Winery[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/f4ce51c5c34bc9712f2d1f9cf6c2907798ad7a9b.jpg[/img]

This is where the “magic” happens, the different stages of the Winery will give the player more space.
We leave it up to you to handle the extra space, you can increase the number of tanks you can fit in your winery to produce more wine, or buy a new machinery to unlock new packaging settings, or a brand new filter to be sure that you will not have problem once the wine is shipped.

[b]Warehouse[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/8246f2ba409b8ff128dbbb557d4f4550fa7f633b.jpg[/img]

In the Warehouse all the marketing and the selling will take place. The evolution of this building will increase the number of bottle you can store, the number of order you can prepare and so on… This will be really handy when you try to scale your global wine export!

[b]Toolshack[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/c23f6e78d083f05f1bb5cb9dba6a13980b940a77.jpg[/img]

You can achieve a good quality wine only if you really take care of your vineyards, this is why you need to upgrade your Toolshack to unlock new tractors and tools that can help you accelerate the work and be more efficient.
 

So this is all for this dev blog, next week we start to go deeper with [b]Season[/b], [b]weather system[/b], [b]soil system[/b]!

notes.title: Dev Blog 01 - Gameplay basics
notes.content:
Hello fellow winelovers!

Today we’d like to start share with you more detail on the gameplay of Hundred Days!

The game has 3 different areas of interest:

[h1]Toolshack[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/a5cb1e9e8918486ba19549fde24d94c8f225805f.png[/img]

With the Toolshack you will handle all the task relative to the vineyards, and will store your tools and tractors.

[h1]Winery[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/4e98ace287856d8a43edb8f834fc33ebb461732f.png[/img]

In the winery you will take care of the winemaking process.

[h1]Warehouse[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/92cd558d16ad6b688d5d506c7d131e2901e4763f.png[/img]

Warehouse is where you will handle the logistics, marketing and selling of your final product

[h1]Board[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/0da1ab78a67999d41152516dcd9db0d270eb13ea.png[/img]
The Board at the center of the screen represent your time. You must organize your day, trying to manage the task you have to do.

Task that you can perform are represented in form of cards. The cards you will receive at the beginning of your turn depend on what you have done in the past turns.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/68c5ee8f89dfe4781154129ea8869d45958e59b4.png[/img]

[h1]Cards[/h1]

Cards can have 3 parameters
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/56639d5187959babef709cce336db0a6ee2f6b33.jpg[/img]

[list][*] Shape: the actual shape once the task is placed on the board
[*] Weather condition: if the card have some limitation or not due to the weather
[*] Cost of the task
[/list]

Once you drag a card on the board the card will change shape:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35414373/c309982b833442a5b6f373364bc59e0fb9b16520.gif[/img]
